en.text:
Scoring 8 hits on an ally within 1 second of each triggers the following actions:
• Grants you 5 ammo and 10 seconds of <strand/>Woven Mail
• Grants the ally 60HP and 10 seconds of <strand/>Woven Mail
• Triggers regeneration for their health, or shields if health is full. Does not heal shields if health is missing

While <strand/>Woven Mail is active, deal <pve 25% /> <pvp [5%] /> increased damage and gain 40 Ammo Generation.
